items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Grossman studied with him, Eddie Daniels, Dave Tofani. These were some of the names of guys that I knew. That’s how I knew Eddie Daniels’s name.

ctx.x: The clarinet was invented by two guys who hated each other.
With all due respect to the great clarinet players in the world, it’s just never been an instrument that turned me on. I love it in classical, and of course, obviously – I

think the reason that it never turned me on, because I always associated it with that sound of swing and that kind of syrupy, corny extension of Jewish klezmer-type playing that I probably never heard. If I had heard Jimmy Giuffre first, I probably would have loved the clarinet, because he was so hip and so cool on it, or if I had heard someone like Eddie Daniels play, but I guess Benny just didn’t get to me when I was a kid. “Aw, that’s the old stuff.” And it’s not fair to clarinet, because, as I’m saying,…
